# libpng-proto / libpng_transformations_fuzzer

libpng-proto's own fuzz target `libpng_transformations_fuzzer` ([source](source/libpng_transformations_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libpng (pnggroup/libpng at cae47455).

Sequential read with quantize/invert_alpha/swap_alpha/packing/alpha_mode transforms, up to 100 rows; rows never inspected.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libpng at commit cae47455.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libpng-proto` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `libpng_transformations_fuzzer.plain` | 159,128 | `49b6863f1b65dee317c886803bc24f582f5173e22f7c1beb757525f490dfce7a` |
| ubsan | `libpng_transformations_fuzzer.ubsan` | 179,160 | `82cc887f127e5c483eed712c9d300f9d39e32926dcadff5fff659085bda135df` |
| asan | `libpng_transformations_fuzzer.asan` | 997,768 | `d0e0433c6ffb992bcfef6691db901e3bfe5835542da3f8d8fcd454975f5967ec` |
| asan-ubsan | `libpng_transformations_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 1,023,976 | `de5ca219278353de66657f2b39615ebe1cd0d628b27fd2d79cbb41e3703b956c` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
